effects: Exactly `assets` msETH (0x6435...5160) leaves the signer for the vault, using the signer's msETH allowance to the vault.

The vault mints gtmsETHc shares to `receiver`. The number of shares is computed from the vault's total assets and supply at execution, after fee shares go to the fee recipient, and there is no minimum.
The vault supplies the deposited msETH to Morpho Blue markets. This is internal to the vault and does not change the signer's position.
formats.shown: Intent "Deposit", with the msETH amount, a fixed "Share ticker: gtmsETHc" line and the share recipient.

findings.title: deposit: the number of gtmsETHc shares received is not shown, and the code sets no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor)`. Shares are computed from storage and there is no minShares parameter. Case 0: the signer received 1000000000000000 gtmsETHc and the screen shows only the ticker.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor. The amount is not in the calldata.

findings.title: deposit: the bare intent "Deposit" and the stand-alone ticker field leave out what is deposited and what comes back.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit: `"intent": "Deposit"`, no interpolatedIntent, a field `{"label":"Share ticker","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker"}` with no amount. Case 0: the blind reader did not know how many shares arrive.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Deposit {assets} into the Gauntlet msETH vault for gtmsETHc shares to {receiver}". Relabel the amount "Amount to deposit" and drop the raw ticker field or rename it "Shares received (gtmsETHc)".

cases.notes: The 0.001 msETH out is shown right. The gtmsETHc shares in are shown with the right asset and recipient but no amount, because the amount is computed. The msETH allowance spent down to 0 is the prerequisite of the deposit and is not shown, which is acceptable (info).

effects: An amount of msETH computed at execution (rounded up from the vault's totals) leaves the signer for the vault, using the signer's msETH allowance. No maximum is given in the calldata.
Fee shares may be minted to the fee recipient first. This changes the share price but not the inputs shown.
formats.shown: Intent "Mint", with the ticker "msETH" as the deposit asset (no amount), the share amount and the share recipient.

findings.title: mint: the msETH amount taken from the signer is not shown and has no maximum in calldata.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);`. Case 1: 1015682796 wei msETH left the signer while the screen shows only "Deposit asset: msETH".
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor. The only bound is the signer's msETH allowance to the vault.

findings.title: mint: the intent "Mint" does not say that the signer pays msETH, and the asset field is a bare ticker.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint: `"intent": "Mint"`, no interpolatedIntent, field `{"label":"Deposit asset","format":"raw","value":"$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}`. Case 1: the blind reader was unsure how much msETH would be deposited.
findings.fix: Intent "Mint vault shares", interpolatedIntent "Mint {shares} by depositing msETH, shares to {receiver}", and label the ticker field "Pays with (amount set by vault)".

cases.notes: The signer paid 1015682796 wei msETH. The screen names the asset but not the amount, and the amount is computed so it cannot be shown. The shares went to 0x...dEaD, which the screen shows right, and the reader understood that no shares came to the signer.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: gtmsETHc shares are burned from `owner`. The number is computed at execution (rounded up) and there is no maximum. When the signer is not `owner`, the signer's share allowance from `owner` is spent.
Exactly `assets` msETH is sent from the vault to `receiver`.
The vault withdraws msETH from Morpho Blue markets to pay out.
formats.shown: Intent "Withdraw", with the exact msETH amount, the recipient and the owner of the shares.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of shares burned from the owner is not shown, and the code sets no maximum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil)`. The value is computed from storage and is not in the calldata.

findings.title: withdraw: the bare intent "Withdraw" does not say that msETH is paid out by burning vault shares.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Withdraw {assets} to {receiver} by burning shares of {owner}".

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Exactly `shares` gtmsETHc are burned from `owner`. When the signer is not `owner`, the signer's share allowance from `owner` is spent.
An amount of msETH computed at execution (rounded down) is sent to `receiver`, with no minimum.
The vault withdraws msETH from Morpho Blue markets to pay out.
formats.shown: Intent "Redeem", with the gtmsETHc share amount, the recipient and the owner.

findings.title: redeem: the msETH amount received is not shown, and the code sets no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.sol redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor)`. The value is computed from storage, with no minAssets parameter.

findings.title: redeem: the bare intent "Redeem" does not say which asset comes back or to whom.
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem: `"intent": "Redeem"`, interpolatedIntent null, and no field names msETH as the asset received.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Redeem {shares} for msETH to {receiver}", or a constant field "Receive: msETH".
